purpose: Adaptive maximum-safe manual reference batch 098: two Miniatures Handbook Repair Damage variants sharing a same-book regression-locked Repair Light Damage base; older duplicate printings intentionally excluded for separate lineage review.

spells/repair-critical-damage-1993.name: Repair Critical Damage
spells/repair-critical-damage-1993.effectSummary: By touching a construct that has at least 1 hit point remaining, repairs 4d8 points of damage +1 point per caster level, maximum +20. It otherwise follows Repair Light Damage's same-book construct-repair rules. The spell is instantaneous, allows no saving throw, and permits spell resistance only as a harmless effect.
spells/repair-critical-damage-1993.notes: Miniatures Handbook printing, digest-locked. The same-book Repair Light Damage source supplies the requirement that the touched construct still have at least 1 hit point and the general construct-repair behavior; this spell changes the repaired amount to 4d8 +1/level (maximum +20). The header's focus component is preserved as printed and is not inferred from the effect prose.
